verdict.summary: Self-serve and quick to start, with no review for your first customers. The catch is money: the free Starter plan stops at 5 connected organisations, and every step up is a paid monthly plan. Certification only comes in above 50.

cost.summary: Free up to 5 connections. Core: $35 AUD/month for up to 50. Plus: $245 AUD/month for up to 1,000 (certification included in the upgrade). Advanced: $1,445 AUD/month for up to 10,000.

firstConnection.definition: You connect your own Xero organisation (or the Xero demo company) through Composio and make an API call.
firstConnection.summary: Same-day. No review or approval stands between you and a working connection.

production.definition: Up to 50 customer organisations can connect (Core plan). Beyond 50 is the 'Scale' stage.
production.summary: No review up to 50 connections: add a payment method and move to Core. Going past 50 needs the Plus plan and certification, and Xero doesn't publish a review timeline.

stages.name: Get a first working connection
stages.unlocks: You and up to 4 more organisations can connect, for free.

steps.title: Sign in to the Xero Developer portal
steps.instructions: Sign in at developer.xero.com with a Xero login (create a free one if needed) and open My Apps.
steps.whyHuman: Creating an account and accepting Xero's developer terms has to be done by you.

steps.title: Register a web app
steps.instructions: Click New app and pick the web app type (standard authorization code flow). Enter your company URL and paste Composio's redirect URI exactly. Then generate a client secret.
steps.agentHelp: The agent prefills the redirect URI (https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add) and the integration name so you can paste them in.
steps.whyHuman: The client secret is shown only in your Xero account. The agent never sees or handles it.

steps.title: Choose scopes
steps.instructions: Start from Composio's default Xero scopes and remove what your agent won't use. Always keep offline_access, or connections stop working after 30 minutes.
steps.agentHelp: The agent lists Composio's 31 default scopes and suggests a read-only set if your agent only reads data.

steps.title: Create a custom auth config in Composio
steps.instructions: In Composio, create an auth config for the Xero toolkit using your own OAuth app: paste the client ID and secret, plus the scopes from the previous step.
steps.whyHuman: This pastes a secret into your Composio account.

steps.title: Connect the Xero demo company and make a test call
steps.instructions: Open a Connect Link, sign in to Xero, choose the demo company, and approve. Then run a read tool (for example, list contacts).

stages.name: Go live with up to 50 customers
stages.unlocks: Up to 50 connected organisations at 5,000 API calls per day per organisation.

steps.title: Move to the Core plan before your 6th connection
steps.instructions: In the Xero Developer portal, add a payment method and move the app to Core ($35 AUD/month).

stages.name: Scale past 50 (certified app partner)
stages.unlocks: Up to 1,000 connections on Plus, more on Advanced/Enterprise, and an optional Xero App Store listing.

steps.title: Upgrade to Plus and get certified
steps.instructions: Upgrade from Core to Plus; certification is part of that upgrade. Xero reviews your integration against its certification checkpoints and may ask you for a test account.
steps.agentHelp: The agent can check your build against the published certification checkpoints and draft the public support documentation Xero asks for.
steps.whyHuman: You submit the application, pay for the plan, and handle any follow-up with Xero's team.

steps.title: Complete Xero's security self-assessment before 1,000 connections
steps.instructions: Xero sends the self-assessment at 800 connections. Until it's approved, you're capped at 999.
steps.whyHuman: It's a security attestation about your company.

requirements.description: A Xero login for the developer portal.
An HTTPS redirect URI (Composio's default works; localhost is allowed only for testing).
A payment method on file for Core and above.
Certification against Xero's checkpoints, as part of the Plus upgrade.

limits.value: 60/minute, 5 concurrent, 1,000/day per org on Starter, 5,000/day on higher plans
Access token 30 minutes, refresh token 60 days

gotchas.cause: The free Starter plan allows 5 connections.
gotchas.fix: Move to Core before you onboard customer #6, or disconnect test organisations you no longer use.

gotchas.symptom: A customer can't connect even though you're under your plan's limit.
gotchas.cause: Each Xero organisation can connect at most 5 uncertified apps. If they already have 5, yours is blocked.
gotchas.fix: The customer disconnects an unused uncertified app, or you get certified.

gotchas.symptom: Agent runs start failing partway through the day on the free plan.
gotchas.cause: Starter allows 1,000 calls per day per organisation, and an agent that loops over invoices can use that up quickly.
gotchas.fix: Batch reads, cache results, or move to Core (5,000/day).

gotchas.symptom: Connections stop working about 30 minutes after a user connects.
gotchas.cause: Without the offline_access scope Xero doesn't issue a refresh token, so the access token can't be renewed.
gotchas.fix: Add offline_access to the auth config's scopes and ask the user to reconnect.

scopeNotes.note: Required for refresh tokens. Without it, connections expire after 30 minutes.
Write access to money movement. Xero doesn't publish scope sensitivity tiers. Drop these if your agent only reads data: it's a smaller consent screen and less risk.

claims.text: Web server apps use the standard authorization code flow; Xero assigns a client ID and you generate a client secret.

sources.title: The standard authorization code flow
sources.quote: Your app is assigned a unique Client ID and you can then generate a Client Secret.

claims.text: The redirect URI must be HTTPS; http://localhost is allowed for testing.

sources.quote: This must be an https address, however for testing you can use http://localhost/

claims.text: Access tokens last 30 minutes. Refresh tokens last 60 days and are only issued when you request offline_access.

sources.quote: Access tokens expire after 30 minutes... You get a refresh token by requesting the offline_access scope... Refresh tokens expire after 60 days.

claims.text: New apps start on the free Starter plan, capped at 5 connections.

sources.quote: New apps default to the starter tier with 5 connections. Moving up to Core will give you up to 50 connections.
Monthly Tier Fee | No charge | $35 AUD | $245 AUD | $1445 AUD | Price on Application

conflicts.otherValue: Uncertified apps are limited to 25 connections.
conflicts.resolution: Superseded. Xero's own limits and pricing pages now say 5 (Starter). The 25 figure reflects Xero's older model.

claims.text: Core costs $35 AUD/month for up to 50 connections and needs a payment method.

sources.quote: Connections (maximum) | 5 | 50 | 1000 | 10,000 | No Limit ... Payment Method | Not Applicable | Required

claims.text: Plus costs $245 AUD/month for up to 1,000 connections, and certification is part of the upgrade from Core.

sources.quote: Once you're on the Core Plan, you can then upgrade to the Plus Plan and get certified as part of the upgrade.

claims.text: Certification reviews your integration against Xero's certification checkpoints and may need a test account. Xero's partner guide also mentions having ten active customer connections in this step (phrase confirmed on the live page; the exact rule still needs confirming).

sources.quote: Reviewing your integration, this is based on the certification checkpoints, additional requirements may apply depending on your use case. You may need to provision a test account for us.

claims.text: A security self-assessment is required before 1,000 connections; until then you're capped at 999. Xero shares it at 800 connections.

sources.quote: Until then, your connection numbers will be capped at 999... We'll share the self-assessment with you once you reach 800 connections

claims.text: Each Xero organisation can connect at most five uncertified apps.

sources.quote: each organisation or practice is limited to connecting a maximum of five uncertified apps. There is no limit on connecting certified apps.

claims.text: 60 calls per minute, 5 concurrent, 1,000 per day per org on Starter and 5,000 per day on higher plans.

sources.quote: Concurrent Limit: 5 calls in progress at one time ... Minute Limit: 60 calls per minute ... Daily Limit: 1,000 calls per day for starter, 5,000 calls per day for higher tiers

claims.text: Composio's default redirect URI for the Xero toolkit is https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add.
Composio requests 31 Xero scopes by default, including write access to payments, bank transactions and manual journals.
A developer can reach a first working connection in 15 to 45 minutes.

evidence.testNote: Not tested yet. Estimated from the number of steps and the absence of any review. Will be replaced by a timed attempt in step 3.

openQuestions.question: Does the Xero demo company count toward the 5 Starter connections?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: If it does, a developer testing with it has only 4 free customer slots.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Connect the demo company in a test attempt and check the connection count in My Apps.

openQuestions.question: What exactly is the 'ten active customer connections' requirement for certification, and how long does review take?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: It decides when a growing app can pass 50 connections.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Read the certification checkpoints page in full; ask Xero API Support for a typical review time.

corrections.before: Uncertified Xero apps are capped at 25 connections.
corrections.after: Starter is capped at 5 (free); Core 50 ($35 AUD/mo); Plus 1,000 ($245 AUD/mo, includes certification).
corrections.why: The 25 figure came from third-party pages (Railz, Retool forum, Stack Overflow) that predate Xero's current pricing model.

corrections.before: Certification requires 3 active connections within 30 days.
corrections.after: Certification is part of upgrading from Core to Plus. Xero's page mentions ten active customer connections; the exact rule is still an open question.
corrections.why: The earlier figure came from a third-party source in prior research; Xero's own partner guide now describes a different path.
